output.objection: You are treating my acceptance of a manual review gate as a free concession rather than a negotiated trade off. I am giving up full automation of the evaluation harness to ensure we meet compliance, and you need to acknowledge that cost explicitly in the plan.
output.correction: I did not agree to slow down the weekly retraining cycle or block the deployment pipeline indefinitely. I am only asking for a human sign off on the final model version before it goes live, which is different from the manual data checks you just proposed.
